prose.en: Tori places his hip against uke's right side, traps uke's right arm under his own left armpit and grips the right sleeve. With his right hand he cradles uke's neck and grips around the right rear collar. Tori spreads both legs widely to the front and rear to keep himself stable, and holds uke down by pressing uke's chest with the right side of his own chest.
Image of the entry and of the hold Tori enters and settles into kesa-gatame. Tori holds uke down while controlling uke's neck and arm.
Uke bridges and turns tori over. Uke takes hold of tori's belt and turns him over with a bridge.
Tori enters into the hold from a standing position over uke. Tori enters while controlling both of uke's legs.

heading.en: Faults that are easy to fall into

prose.en: Tori should make sure that the spread of his legs is not the wrong way round.
Tori must not hold uke down by controlling the neck alone.
